results.question: 各付款方式的付款總金額
results.sql: SELECT pos_payment.payment_method AS payment_method, SUM(pos_payment.payment_amount) AS "付款總金額" FROM public.pos_payment LEFT JOIN public.pos_sale ON pos_payment.transaction_no = pos_sale.transaction_no WHERE pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL GROUP BY pos_payment.payment_method ORDER BY payment_method NULLS FIRST
results.interpretation: metric paid_amount over pos_payment; by pos_payment.payment_method
assumptions: Rows of segment 'returns' (transactions that reference an origin transaction are returns; rule and default exclusion confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-09) are excluded by default; say '退貨' to include them.
pos_payment rows are joined to pos_sale through pos_payment.transaction_no; rows without a matching pos_sale row keep NULL there.

付款總金額 = Sum of pos_payment.payment_amount. Payments carry no status: every pos_payment row is a completed payment, so 'paid' means every payment. Time is the sale_date of the paid transaction. Signed by the owner on 2026-09-09.
No row filter was applied beyond the time window; every pos_payment row counts, including any status the question did not mention.
No time window was applied; all rows count.

results.question: 2026年1月各門市的營業額
results.sql: SELECT store.store_name AS store_name, SUM(pos_sale.total_amount) AS gross_sales FROM public.pos_sale LEFT JOIN public.store ON pos_sale.store_id = store.store_id WHERE pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL AND (pos_sale.sale_date >= %(p1_start_0)s AND pos_sale.sale_date < %(p1_end_1)s) GROUP BY store.store_name ORDER BY store_name NULLS FIRST
results.interpretation: metric gross_sales over pos_sale; by store.store_name; for 2026-01
assumptions: pos_sale rows are joined to store through pos_sale.store_id; rows without a matching store row keep NULL there.

gross_sales = Sum of pos_sale.total_amount over sales that are not returns (origin_transaction_no is null): gross sales, the denominator of return ratios by retail convention. Signed by the owner on 2026-09-10. Per product or per category sales are line_sales over pos_saleitem, not this metric.
No row filter was applied beyond the time window; every pos_sale row counts, including any status the question did not mention.
